content_sections.text: Read the official notification carefully before attending the interview. Candidates must report at the venue as per the reporting time mentioned in the notification. Bring the duly filled application form if required in the notification. Verify eligibility criteria before attending the interview. Candidates are advised to reach the venue well in advance to complete registration formalities. Keep extra passport-size photographs for submission if required.

faq.answer: The post name for the KVS Madanapalle recruitment is Primary Teacher. This is a contractual position.

faq.question: Q2. What is the total number of vacancies for the Primary Teacher post?
faq.answer: As per the provided data, there are 0 vacancies for the Primary Teacher post. Candidates are advised to check the official notification for the most accurate information.

faq.question: Q3. What is the salary offered for the Primary Teacher position?
faq.answer: The salary offered for the Primary Teacher position is Rs. 21250/- consolidated pay per month.

faq.question: Q4. What are the educational qualifications required for the Primary Teacher role?
faq.answer: Candidates need to have Senior Secondary/Intermediate (10+2) with at least 50% marks and a 2-year Diploma in Elementary Education (D.El.Ed) or equivalent, along with CTET Paper-1.

faq.question: Q5. What is the application mode for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The application mode for this recruitment is Walk-in. Candidates need to attend the interview in person.

faq.question: Q6. When is the Walk-in Interview scheduled?
faq.answer: The Walk-in Interview is scheduled for 11 September 2026.

faq.question: Q7. What is the selection process for the KVS Madanapalle Primary Teacher recruitment?
faq.answer: The selection process includes a Walk-in Interview and Document Verification.

faq.question: Q8. Is there any application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) in the provided data.

faq.question: Q9. What documents should I carry for the Walk-in Interview?
faq.answer: You should carry all original documents along with one set of self-attested photocopies, including ID proof, educational certificates, and category certificates if applicable.
